title: Qualify exact-rational to binary64 rounding, explicit matrix loss and provider-copy boundaries
commitMessage: feat: qualify explicit rational-to-binary64 numerical boundaries

contribution.summary: Qualify M3-W01-C02-T2 with a controlled RED, 19 independent numerical GREEN tests, full Math regressions, explicit nearest-even rational-to-binary64 conversion and typed precision-loss, underflow, overflow and budget outcomes. Verify copy-only matrices and local provider-neutral NuGet 0.4.0-preview.2; complete C02 without closing M3.
contribution.value: A qualified consumer can choose exact-only or admitted approximate binary64 matrix conversion and inspect typed errors without silent rational widening, partial results, aliases, or dependencies on a specific numerical provider.
debtChanges: Discovery remains a separate proposed M3-W03 work package; it cannot claim native DWF adoption before Workflow issue 139 authoring and sibling-continuation support are qualified and installed.
The neutral dw.discovery project under aihallot/dw.tools remains at the independent planning/adoption stage; this numerical run neither duplicates its contract nor publishes a Math agent skill.
No native BLAS, untested operating-system RID, external provider availability, AURA authorization or Decision adoption is inferred from the local managed package check.
IEEE 754 nearest-even reporting is mathematically exact for bounded rational operands, but a rounded value does not become exact algebraic equality or certify downstream solver conditioning.

Verify the 4096-bit operand boundary through actual conversion outcomes (4096 bits accepted for evaluation, 4097 bits refused), not a tautological constant assertion (MSTEST0032). Underflow, overflow and bit-budget refusals never yield a partial matrix.
Closing M3-W01-C02 does not complete M3-W01 or M3; the next planned numerical chunk is M3-W01-C03 for solving and decompositions.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS041 success, prepare a substantive M3-W01-C03 numerical solve and decomposition slice under the existing native DWF plan, while monitoring the separate generic dw.discovery and Workflow issue 139 gates.

Nineteen independent numerical GREEN oracles, recovered RED, full Math regressions, copy/alias checks and local provider-free NuGet 0.4.0-preview.2 manifest pass.
Qualify declared exact-versus-approximate conversion, loss reporting and provider-load boundaries without changing third-party numerical packages or claiming external consumers.
Both accepted numerical matrix/vector tasks T1 and T2 are done with durable evidence; M3 and its numerical work package remain in progress for solving and decompositions.
